source.rdkit: each component file's SMILES read by RDKit: every atom's element, its hydrogens (GetTotalNumHs) and formal charge, summed; sanitized where RDKit allows, and read by its valence model alone where it doesn't (rdkit_sanitized false)
source.chemicals: chemicals.identifiers.search_chemical(cas).formula, from chemicals' database (PubChem's formulas), or null where it has no such CAS number
source.weights: chemicals.elements.periodic_table[z].MW, g/mol, for z from 1 to 92
